title: Variable Data
description: Personalize every piece of mail with variable data printing. Increase engagement by dynamically changing text and graphics based on recipient data.

featureLeft.heading: Variable data makes printing personal
featureLeft.subDescription: Variable data printing (VDP) allows you to customize each individual printed piece in a direct mail campaign based on data you have about the recipient. By tailoring graphics and text to specific individuals, you can significantly boost response rates.

featureRight.heading: Boost business growth with customized print marketing
featureRight.subDescription: Direct mail statistics consistently show that personalized mail performs significantly better than generic mailings. Speak directly to your customer's unique needs.
features: Increases response rates by up to 30%

howItWorks.heading: How does variable data printing work?
howItWorks.subDescription: We merge your customer database with our high-speed digital printing presses to produce thousands of unique, personalized pieces seamlessly.
